description: Source code for unit tests of the StateMachineManager component in Orleans' journaling infrastructure. The tests cover registration, recovery, concurrency, and large data handling for durable state machines.

classes.name: StateMachineManagerTests
classes.description: Unit test class for the StateMachineManager component, verifying registration, recovery, concurrency, and large state handling.

methods.name: StateMachineManager_RegisterStateMachine_Test
methods.description: Tests registration and basic operation of multiple durable state machines within the manager.

methods.name: StateMachineManager_StateRecovery_Test
methods.description: Verifies that state is recoverable and consistent after persistence.

methods.name: StateMachineManager_MultipleWriteStates_Test
methods.description: Checks multiple write cycles with intermediate operations, ensuring final consistency.

methods.name: StateMachineManager_MultipleStateMachines_Test
methods.description: Ensures multiple different types of state machines can operate and recover independently.

methods.name: StateMachineManager_Concurrency_Test
methods.description: Validates isolation and correct concurrent modifications across multiple state machines.

methods.name: StateMachineManager_LargeStateRecovery_Test
methods.description: Stress test for recovering large state with thousands of entries.
